mapper.select: SELECT bk.SEQNO as seqno, bk.BOOK_DATE as bookDate, bk.HAPPEN_DATE as happenDate, bk.BOOKSET_ID AS booksetId, bb.BOOKSET_NAME as booksetName, bk.BOOK_ID as bookId, bk.SUBJECT_NO as subjectNo, bs.SUBJECT_NAME AS subjectName, bk.CD_FLAG AS cdFlag, bk.O_CCY AS ccy, bk.O_HAPPEN_AMT as happenAmt, bk.HAPPEN_NUMBER as happenNumber, bk.TABLE_ID as tableId, bk.BUSI_ID as busiId, fp.FINPROD_ABBR as busiName, bk.TRADE_ID as tradeId, fpd.P_TRADE_ID AS pTradeId, bk.OFFSET_FLAG AS offsetFlag, bk.BOOK_REMARK as bookRemark FROM BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT bk LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bb on bk.BOOKSET_ID = bb.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_TABLELIST bt on bt.TABLE_ID = bk.TABLE_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT bs ON bs.BOOKSET_ID = bb.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL AND bs.SUBJECT_NO = bk.SUBJECT_NO LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON fp.FINPROD_ID = bk.BUSI_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL fpd ON fpd.TRADE_ID = bk.TRADE_ID WHERE bk.SEQNO = #{seqno}

SELECT * FROM( SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_NO AS subjectNo, SUBJECT_NAME AS subjectName, ACC_QUA_FLAG AS accQuaFlag, GEN_DETSUB_FLAG AS genDetsubFlag, BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE AS baseSubjectNature, FSUBJECT_ID AS fsubjectId FROM BOK_SUBJECT WHERE BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND CONNECT_BY_ISLEAF = 1 CONNECT BY FSUBJECT_ID = PRIOR SUBJECT_NO AND BOOKSET_ID = PRIOR BOOKSET_ID ) TMP WHERE TMP.subjectNo = #{subjectNo}
SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_NO as id, SUBJECT_NAME as text FROM BOK_SUBJECT WHERE BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND CONNECT_BY_ISLEAF = 1 CONNECT BY FSUBJECT_ID = PRIOR SUBJECT_NO

SELECT bk.SEQNO AS seqno, bk.BUSI_ID AS busiId, bk.SUBJECT_NO AS subjectNo, bs.SUBJECT_NAME AS subjectName, bk.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO AS detailSubjectNo, bbd.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NAME AS detaiSubjectName, bk.CD_FLAG AS cdFlag, bk.O_CCY AS ccy, bk.O_HAPPEN_AMT AS happenAmt, bk.HAPPEN_NUMBER AS happenNumber FROM BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT bk LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bb ON bk.BOOKSET_ID = bb.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT bs ON bs.SUBJECT_NO = bk.SUBJECT_NO AND bs.BOOKSET_ID = bb.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL LEFT JOIN BOK_BUSS_DETSUB bbd ON bbd.BOOKSET_ID = bk.BOOKSET_ID AND bbd.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO = bk.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO WHERE bk.BOOK_ID = #{bookId}

SELECT BCI.ACCT_NO AS code, BCI.ACCT_NO AS name, BCI.ACCT_NO AS shortName,
#{finprodType} AS hidCode
BCI.ACCT_NO AS hidCode
FROM BOK_BOOKSET_CAPACCT_INFO BCI WHERE BCI.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}

SELECT distinct FP.FINPROD_ID AS code, FP.FINPROD_ID AS name, FP.FINPROD_ID AS shortName, FP.FINPROD_TYPE AS hidCode FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT FP WHERE 1=1 and FP.FINPROD_TYPE not in ('F01','F06','F10')
AND FP.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}
AND FP.FINPROD_TYPE IN ('F01','F02','F03','F04','F05','F08','F09','F23','F24','F35')
AND (FP.BRANCH = '0' OR FP.BRANCH IS NULL)

SELECT BCI.ACCT_NO AS id, BCI.ACCT_NO AS text FROM BOK_BOOKSET_CAPACCT_INFO BCI WHERE BCI.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}
AND BCI.ACCT_NO like concat(param,'%')
SELECT TASK_ID taskId, TASK_PRI taskPri FROM SYS_BATCH_TASK WHERE BEAN_NAME = #{beanName} AND ROWNUM <= 1
mapper.delete: delete from TRD_VOUCH_DEAL_DETAIL where TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}
delete from BOK_BOOKDETAIL_ALL where TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}
delete from BOK_VOUCH_DETAIL where TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and VOUCH_NUM = #{vouchNum}
mapper.select: SELECT a.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID AS code, b.acct_subject_name AS name, a.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE AS hidCode, b.acct_subject_name AS shortName FROM BOK_BOOKSET a LEFT JOIN BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO b on a.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = b.acct_subject_id and a.acct_subject_type = b.acct_subject_type WHERE a.bookset_id = #{booksetId}

SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_NO id, SUBJECT_NAME text FROM BOK_SUBJECT WHERE SUBJECT_LEVEL = #{level3}
AND (SUBJECT_NO LIKE '%'||#{search}||'%' OR SUBJECT_NAME LIKE '%'||#{search}||'%')

SELECT A.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId, A.FINPROD_TYPE AS finprodType FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT A INNER JOIN FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE B ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_TYPE = B.FINPROD_TYPE WHERE A.BRANCH = 0 AND A.BRANCH_TYPE IS NULL AND A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND A.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}

SELECT TMP.* FROM( SELECT A.BOOKSET_ID, A.BUSI_ID, A.BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE, A.INV_AIM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER( PARTITION BY A.BOOKSET_ID, A.BUSI_ID, A.BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE ORDER BY A.UPDATE_TIME DESC ) AS RN FROM BOK_DETAIL_ID A WHERE A.BUSI_ID=#{busiId} AND A.BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE = #{busiDetailType} AND A.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND A.INV_AIM != #{invAimSell} ) TMP WHERE TMP.RN = 1

SELECT distinct FP.FINPROD_ID AS code, FP.FINPROD_ID AS name, FP.FINPROD_ID AS shortName, FP.FINPROD_TYPE AS hidCode FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT FP left join fin_product_add fpd on fp.finprod_id = fpd.finprod_id WHERE 1=1 and FP.FINPROD_TYPE in ('F01','F06','F10') and fpd.appear_market_id is null
AND FP.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}
AND FP.FINPROD_TYPE IN ('F01','F02','F03','F04','F05','F08','F09','F23','F24','F35')
AND (FP.BRANCH = '0' OR FP.BRANCH IS NULL)
